intent: Centered explanation for a region with nothing in it yet (empty backlog, no search results, no notifications): optional illustration circle, a title, subtle description text, and a row of next-step actions. Max 460px wide, centered in its container.

structure.description: Optional leading illustration slot. Default look is a 96px sunken circle holding one large glyph span; an or inline
The headline (h500 scale). Use a real heading element at the level that fits the page outline.
Subtle supporting copy under the title.
Centered row (8px gap) of next-step actions — typically one .btn-primary plus a .btn-subtle.

a11yNotes: Use a real heading element for .empty-state-title so the state participates in the page outline. The default media glyph is decorative — mark it aria-hidden="true" (an illustration should instead get alt="" when purely decorative). Actions must be real buttons or links; lead with the primary next step.
